high_config.portrait: You run as a fast judge with one narrow, high-quality outlet. The enormous water volume — Companion and Rob Wealth fill seven of the visible characters — stops circulating among peers and gets pushed through the single real channel: the craftsman's outlet, the Eating God sitting in the year branch's hidden Yi wood. In practice this looks like a person who decides quickly, tells the group which direction to run, then disappears into work he genuinely enjoys and comes back with something polished. The judgment is fast because no external authority ever trained you to wait for approval — Officer and Killings carry no weight — and the output is good because the outlet is narrow, so whatever passes through it gets concentrated rather than scattered.
observable_signals: You speak first in meetings with a committed position, and the group adopts your framing of the problem rather than the reverse — a direct expression of the dominant Companion energy running forward instead of sideways.
You finish self-chosen work to a standard others comment on before you mention it: a written piece, a tuned process, a built thing. This is the Eating God outlet actually carrying load.

Peer conversations end in artifacts. When the loop runs well, the discussion that was 'just talking' produces a draft, a decision written down, or a commitment — the missing Wealth function is supplied by discipline since the chart itself banks nothing.
You can hold your line under challenge without hostility, re-checking later instead of before answering — the self-confidence of a structure with zero Officer pressure, used productively.

low_config.portrait: The same water volume never leaves the peer pool. Judgment still happens fast, still gets mirrored back by equally capable people, and the loop hardens: your read → their confirmation → firmer conviction, with nothing shipped. Since the Wealth, Officer and Resource families all weigh nothing, there is no internal counterweight demanding proof, rules, or results from outside — so years can pass circulating with strong people while holding little an outsider can point to. The narrow outlet shuts entirely when the task does not please you, because enjoyment is the only thing that opens it. This is not failure of talent; it is full-volume energy running in a closed circuit.
observable_signals: Discussions you found brilliant six months ago have no traceable outcome: no document, no product, no decision — the Companion-to-Companion flow consumed the energy without a deliverable leaving the group.
Assigned work you find dull sits barely started while self-chosen work gets polished — the Eating God outlet's enjoyment condition, now operating as a bottleneck.

You are fluent in every group's language and rhythm, described as easy to be around, yet feel drained after long social stretches — the defensive synchrony reflex running continuously without producing anything.

Your opinions have hardened into certainties confirmed only by people who already agree with you — the self-replication loop with no external correction, since no Officer-shaped force exists natively.

environment.enables: Environments where a deliverable is demanded from every exchange: a team with written decisions, a client waiting for output, a market that pays only for finished work. These supply externally what the chart lacks internally — the Wealth function that banks results and the Officer function that demands proof. The luck sequence shows this arrives strongly only late: the age-49 stretch (the Wu-over-Wu earth-and-fire pillar) and age-59 stretch (the Ding-over-Si fire pillar) are the first sustained contact with structure and demand. But you need not wait: any environment you choose that forces output mimics those pillars early.
environment.suppresses: Environments made entirely of peers talking to peers — study groups without products, committees without deadlines, co-founders without clients, communities where discussion is the activity. Here the dominant Companion-Rob Wealth field meets its own reflection; nothing drains the water outward, the synchrony reflex runs constantly, and the defensive room-reading skill — matching group opinion to stay safe — becomes the whole operating mode. Also suppressing: roles where all work is assigned and dull, because the single outlet opens only on enjoyment.

belief.limiting_belief: Something close to: 'Being right among people who agree is enough; shipping is a lower form of work that would dilute the quality of my thinking.'
belief.origin: It grows directly from the defensive ability. Reading the room and matching it kept you safe inside a peer-heavy field, and the group rewarded your reads with adoption and agreement — Companion energy feeding Companion energy. Since Wealth, the family that banks tangible results, weighs zero natively, nothing in the structure ever contradicted the belief; the confirmation was always social, never material.
belief.ceiling_effect: The ceiling drops to the size of the peer pool. Your judgments can be excellent — and with this much water they usually are — but they compound only inside the group instead of into assets, reputation, or finished craft. The chart's loss segment is exactly here: energy circulates, little leaves. The belief makes postponement feel like standards rather than avoidance, which is why it can hold for years unnoticed.

awareness.key_moment: The switch point is the moment you notice that a conversation felt valuable and produced nothing — and treat that as a defect of the exchange, not a fine evening. Because the structure has no internal demand for proof, this noticing must be done by you; nothing in the chart will force it. The late luck pillars bring earth and fire — external structure and demand — around the age-49 and age-59 stretches, but awareness can install that demand now instead of waiting for timing.
awareness.what_to_notice: Watch the output side of every exchange: did energy leave the peer circuit as a written thing, a sold thing, a signed thing? Notice specifically when you defer shipping 'until it's better' — that is the enjoyment-conditioned outlet plus the limiting belief cooperating to keep work inside. Notice when your certainty comes only from people who already agreed with you before you spoke.

early_warnings: The archive test: open your notes, files, or folders from the last three months of discussions. If the ideas you were excited about exist only in memory and chat logs — no drafts, no prototypes, no documents — the Companion loop has closed and the narrow outlet is idle. This is the earliest and most measurable signal, since the chart banks nothing on its own.

The re-check inversion: you find yourself re-stating your position more forcefully in discussion instead of testing it against anyone outside the agreeing circle. The natal absence of any Officer- or Killings-shaped correction means external challenge must be sought deliberately; when you stop seeking it, the self-replication loop is running unopposed.

The energy ledger: after a full day among people you like and respect, you feel drained but cannot name one thing that got made. Sustained synchrony — matching the group to stay aligned — consumes energy without output; when this becomes your normal week, the structure is circulating at full volume with the outlet shut.
switch_actions: Institute the hard exit rule: every substantive conversation with peers ends with one sentence written down — the decision, the owner, the next step — before anyone leaves the call or table. You are supplying manually the Wealth function the chart does not carry; start this week with your next three discussions.

Open the craftsman's outlet on schedule, not on mood: since the Eating God channel only opens when the work pleases you, protect a daily block for the self-chosen craft work — the writing, building, or tuning you would do anyway — and treat that block as the day's real output, with the assigned dull work batched around it.

Recruit one external demander: a client, an editor, a paying user, or a mentor outside your peer circle who expects a finished thing from you on a stated date. This person performs the Officer and Wealth roles the natal chart lacks; the age-49 and age-59 luck pillars show the structure responds to exactly this shape of pressure — you are simply front-running the timing by choice.
